subject: Echelon DataWorks — Purchase onboarding: PO attributes, net terms, and payment rail
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@echelondw.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Banerjee <priya.b@echelondw.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Purchase onboarding details and formatting questions

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the demo last week — the platform looks promising and our legal/procurement teams are now working on paperwork. Two quick asks so we can get the PO issued without back-and-forth: 

1) PO fields: our AP system requires a single header string for "PO Reference" (max 40 chars) and a separate Line-Item code column. Can you confirm Redwood can accept a PO where the main header is a single alphanumeric token and the line items map to the SKU field?

2) Net terms: our default is net60 but we can move to net45 with an operational discount. What level of discount would Redwood need to consider net45 (we're targeting a 10% ARR commitment in year 1)?

3) Invoice cadence: we'd prefer monthly consolidated invoices. Are weekly/biweekly invoice lanes possible if we require the invoices to reference the PO header and a charge code per line?

I've attached our PO requirements spreadsheet and a short SOC2 confirmation request (for your security team). Please send the Redwood PO template if you have a preferred mapping.

Thanks — if easier we can jump on a 20-min call later this week.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Procurement | Echelon DataWorks
liam.oconnor@echelondw.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Echelon_PO_requirements.xlsx, SOC2-summary.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@echelondw.com>
Cc: Priya Banerjee <priya.b@echelondw.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase onboarding details and formatting questions

Hi Liam — appreciate the details and the spreadsheet, that helps a lot. Quick answers below and then I copied Vanessa (billing) and Vivek (sales ops) to align on the discount and invoice flow.

- PO header / line items: Yes, we can accept a single PO Reference header (<= 40 chars). We'll map line items to SKU/charge codes — I'll attach our Redwood_PO_template.pdf with recommended column mapping.

- Invoice cadence: Monthly consolidated invoices are standard and supported. We can also do biweekly if you need invoices tied to specific reporting cycles; weekly is possible but would add operational overhead on our side (we'd prefer monthly or biweekly).

- Net terms / discount: Vivek, can you confirm the program for net45 in exchange for an operational discount for a 10% ARR commitment? If there is room we'll propose a structured discount (tiered by committed spend).

I'll send the template now. If you want a short call to finalize fields, Vanessa and I are available Thursday morning.

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Head of Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

Attachment: Redwood_PO_template.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@echelondw.com>
Cc: Priya Banerjee <priya.b@echelondw.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase onboarding details and formatting questions

Markus / Liam — quick note on the net45 request. For a first-year committed ARR of >=10%, we can offer net45 with a 4% operational discount applied to usage billing (applies to committed spend only). Details: 

- Commitment tiers:
  - 10% ARR commit: 4% discount, net45
  - 20% ARR commit: 6% discount, net45
  - 30%+ ARR commit: custom pricing and extended billing flexibility

- Invoice mapping: We need the PO header to match exactly to the vendor ID in our billing system. For consolidated monthly invoices we will include the PO Reference and SKU-level breakdown. For biweekly we will still reference PO and provide a monthly reconciliation statement.

Liam — if that discount structure sounds reasonable I can draft the quote and rider language for the SOW. Vanessa — can you confirm any operational constraints on biweekly invoices (cutoff times, remittance details)?

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@echelondw.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Banerjee <priya.b@echelondw.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase onboarding details and formatting questions

Vivek / Markus — thanks, that structure should work for Echelon. We'll target the 10% ARR commitment for year 1. A couple of follow-ups before we proceed: 

- Can you send the rider language or sample SOW clauses that codify the 4% operational discount tied to committed spend? We'll route that to legal for redlines.
- We'll use monthly consolidated invoices with the option to request biweekly lanes during ramp. Please include the exact PO header field name to be used (so our ERP maps correctly).

If you can send the quote and the PO template with the exact header name I can get the PO out early next week. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Liam
